title: LMS instructor dashboard — Lanternhall
notes: v2 is a Chakra UI rewrite (chakra-* plus emotion css-* classes). The horizontal global nav becomes a sidebar with icons, a new 'Analytics' item and Gradebook moved up (a hidden Chakra drawer repeats the nav; course cards also carry 'Gradebook' links). Course cards become <lh-course-card> web components (declarative shadow roots), sorted by course code, with the code moved into the banner and '64 students' -> '64 enrolled'. The grading table becomes a list sorted by newest due date with a new item on top and 'Start grading' -> 'Grade'. The announcement form becomes an <announcement-composer> shadow root: Subject (was Title) and 'Post to' (was Course) swap places, ids/names change and 'Post announcement' becomes 'Post'; hidden quick-reply forms in a new discussions card each have a 'Post' button.
